mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (chat_room_id, member_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{chatRoomId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, NOW())
INSERT INTO message_read_status (message_id, member_id, chat_room_id, is_read) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{memberId}, #{chatRoomId}, #{isRead})
INSERT INTO chat_room (is_group_chat, name, market_no, my_name, other_name, my_id, other_id) VALUES (#{isGroupChat}, #{name}, #{marketNo}, #{myName}, #{otherName}, #{myId}, #{otherId})
mapper.select: SELECT c.content AS message, m.member_id AS sender_id, m.member_name AS sender_name, m.member_thumb AS sender_thumb, (SELECT hex_code FROM color_tbl WHERE color_id = m.current_color_id) AS hex_code FROM chat_message c INNER JOIN member_tbl m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE chat_room_id = #{id} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT p.chat_room_id AS room_id, r.name AS room_name, r.is_group_chat, r.my_name, r.other_name, r.market_no, r.my_id, r.other_id FROM chat_participant p INNER JOIN chat_room r ON p.chat_room_id = r.id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY p.chat_room_id DESC
